name: barbell split jerk
description: An overhead lift where you dip, drive and catch the bar with locked arms in a split stance.
instructions: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip a short way with your torso upright.
Drive up explosively and press the bar overhead.
Split your feet front and back and catch with locked arms.
Bring your feet back together and lower the bar with control.
